data.body:
RESOLUTION — landed as Gerrit change 2194 (merged commit 7c7aa830637f on main).

Fix: CompletionAgentStep.run's `except LLMUnavailableError` arm now calls _degrade_from_actionable_bank after stamping the failure diagnostic. When the criterion bank already holds an operator-actionable BLOCK/FAIL (a genuine refutation: met is False AND evidence_sufficient is not False, i.e. NOT the bounded-fallback insufficiency placeholder, NOT a PASS), it finalizes a deterministic verdict via assemble_deterministic_verdict (verdict=FAIL, finalizer=deterministic_fallback, certifiable=False) with NO further LLM calls, honoring the module's 'can never die verdict-less' invariant. This flows to close_precheck's verdict!=PASS branch → returncode 1, non-close, findings surfaced (operator-actionable BLOCK; no uncertified auto-close). Empty / PASS-only / insufficiency-only banks return None → re-raise → exit-11 'transient — retry' posture preserved per ADR 0040 (unchanged, no ADR amendment — the operator decision REJECTED 'sustained outage detection').

Tests: tests/unit/workflow/test_completion_outage_degrade_b39a.py (6 held-out tests). RED→GREEN confirmed; defect-seeded mutation (neuter degrade → degraded=None) returned the actionable test to RED (re-raised LLMUnavailableError), restored to GREEN. Asserts observable behavior (verdict/certifiable/StepResult/re-raise), not private names.

Gates green on both patchsets: lint, typecheck, complexity-baseline (new=0/increased=0), module-size (completion_recovery.py 519 LOC < 800), completion+close test subsets. Plan-review PASS (attested); LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1 (CI) on patchset 2; 0 unresolved comments; submitted (Rebase-If-Necessary → rebased to 7c7aa83).

Classification: plan_defect — the original completion-gate recovery design lacked a bank-only degrade on retryable outage (the deterministic no-LLM fallback was reachable only from typed-exhaustion arms after further LLM calls). Follow-up to bug 8c8a's banked-progress RCA.
